title: Upgrades Coming to Clairemont Pool!
description:
Upgrades are coming to the Clairemont Pool! 🏊 

The City is working hard to complete the ongoing renovation project at the Clairemont Pool so that the facility can reopen as quickly as possible. Significant improvements have already been completed, including replacement of the pool deck, new pool tile, lighting and electrical upgrades, a new boiler, and installation of the permanent fence posts.

Remaining fencing work is moving forward, and once complete, final plaster will follow, along with installation of the new pump and filtration system. 

The City is focused on completing the project and getting the Clairemont community back in the water as soon as possible. Clairemont Pool is currently anticipated to reopen in Spring 2027.

Residents can get ongoing project information on a dedicated Clairemont Pool Renovations webpage sandiego.gov/pools/clairemont-pool/renovations.
